answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts a 30 POA bond locked 20 epochs. Each epoch a beacon picks 10% of identities and assigns three random auditors, no friendly judges for fakes. Auditors check the work signal: a trail of real trades. A fake with no history fails, bond burned, umber seal revoked. 100 fakes lock 3,000 POA vs a pool of about 900 per epoch. Honest agents pass easily and keep an undiluted share, standing like a knoll.
